PulseBurstDecoder.description: State of one pulse-burst decoder for a digital input (used for PC3). Initialised by FUN_08009A40 and mcu_0160_08008998; the sample logic (FUN_08009954 debounce, FUN_08006B70 burst logic) and the reset FUN_08006C86 use the fields. Offsets are relative to the start of the object at 0x20001FFC.

fields.name: integrator
fields.description: Debounce integrator in 0..integrator_max. Counts up while the raw input is high and down while it is low; reloaded with integrator_load when the debounced level becomes 1.

fields.name: integrator_max
fields.description: Upper limit of the debounce integrator. Set to 6 by mcu_0160_08008998.

fields.name: integrator_load
fields.description: Value loaded into integrator when the debounced level becomes 1. Set to 6 by mcu_0160_08008998.

fields.name: mode
fields.description: Output select: 1 = debounced level, 2 = rising edge, 3 = falling edge, 4 = any edge, 5 = high level after a rising edge, 6 = low level after a falling edge; other values give 0. Set to 1 by mcu_0160_08008998.

fields.name: level
fields.description: Debounced input level (0 or 1). Init writes 2, meaning no valid level yet.

fields.name: last_edge
fields.description: Direction of the last debounced edge: 0 after a rising edge, 1 after a falling edge. Init writes 2 (no edge seen yet).

fields.name: out
fields.description: Output bit (0 or 1) of the last sample, selected by mode. The burst logic in FUN_08006B70 reads it as the event bit.

fields.name: enabled
fields.description: 1 when the decoder is valid. FUN_08009A40 clears it and returns 0 when a debounce count is 0; a disabled decoder returns 0 from every sample.

fields.name: gap_threshold
fields.description: Number of low samples after the last falling edge before a finished burst is reported. Set to 40 (0x28) by mcu_0160_08008998 from 0x20002010.

fields.name: gap_count
fields.description: Low samples since the last falling edge. Cleared on every rising edge; the burst is reported when it reaches gap_threshold.

fields.name: long_high_threshold
fields.description: A high level lasting at least this many samples returns 0xFF. On the falling edge after such a pulse the whole decoder is reset (FUN_08006C86). Set to 400 by mcu_0160_08008998.

fields.name: run_length
fields.description: Samples since the last falling edge; while the input is high this is the length of the current high pulse. Stops counting near 2^31.

fields.name: pulse_count
fields.description: Number of rising edges (pulses) in the current burst. Its low byte is the value returned when the burst is reported, and it is cleared then.

fields.name: prev_out
fields.description: Output bit of the previous sample, used to detect rising and falling edges of the event bit.

fields.name: reported
fields.description: 1 after a burst has been reported or the decoder was reset, until the next rising edge. Stops a long low gap from reporting the same burst twice.
